commitResults.messageTitle: Rename Duke project to LuckyNoSlacky
commitResults.messageBody:
The starter project uses Duke as its application name and banner.
Rename the application and update its documentation and banner for the
LuckyNoSlacky chatbot.

commitResults.messageTitle: Implement greeting and exit flow
Extract greeting and exit helpers
Add command echoing
commitResults.messageBody:
The chatbot needs to accept user input before it can support commands.
Read input from standard input, echo non-exit commands, and exit on bye.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add TaskMaster for in-memory task storage
commitResults.messageBody:
The chatbot needs in-memory storage for user-entered tasks.
Add TaskMaster with bounded storage and list support, then route list and
new-task commands through it.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add TaskMaster tests and Gradle setup
commitResults.messageBody:
Task storage needs automated checks and a repeatable test setup.
Add JUnit tests and Gradle configuration for running them with Java 25.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add AI declaration to README.md
Add present-changes-visually skill
commitResults.messageBody:
Code changes are easier to review when they can be inspected visually.
Add a project-specific skill that generates self-contained split-view diffs.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task completion support
commitResults.messageBody:
Users need to track which tasks are complete.
Add completion state, mark command handling, and tests for the behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task unmarking support
commitResults.messageBody:
Users need to reverse an incorrect completion status.
Add unmark command handling and tests for restoring tasks to not done.

commitResults.messageTitle: Introduce Task class and refactor task storage
commitResults.messageBody:
Task state and display logic should not be coupled to TaskMaster storage.
Introduce Task as the task representation and move completion behavior into
it while preserving TaskMaster's storage responsibilities.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add typed task support without inheritance
commitResults.messageBody:
Users need separate formats for ToDos, deadlines, and events.
Store task type and date/time strings, parse the new commands, and display
the corresponding metadata without introducing subclasses yet.

commitResults.messageTitle: Introduce task subclasses for task types
commitResults.messageBody:
Task-specific data and formatting should be owned by each task type.
Introduce TodoTask, DeadlineTask, and EventTask subclasses, move their
parsers into the relevant classes, and keep task creation error handling
centralized in LuckyNoSlacky.
